title: Typhoon Dujuan leaves two dead, 46,000 houses without power in Japan
summary: Typhoon Dujuan left at least two people dead and five injured in Japan, while thousands of houses near Tokyo remained without power after the storm swept through the region, authorities said Tuesday.
